title: Seetha's reply
introduction: In this chapter Seetha replies to Ravana saying that He should seek friendship with Rama and return Her back to Rama.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकविंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 21st Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तद्वचनम् श्रुत्वा सीता रौद्रस्य रक्षसः |
आर्ता दीनस्वरा दीनम् प्रत्युवाच ततः शनैः
verses.iast:
tasya tadvacanam śrutvā sītā raudrasya rakṣasaḥ |
ārtā dīnasvarā dīnam pratyuvāca tataḥ śanaiḥ
verses.translation: Seetha listening to that horrible ogre's word, being tormented spoke in reply with a pitiable voice, pitifully and slowly.

verses.devanagari:
दुःखार्ता रुदती सीता वेपमाना तपस्विनी |
चिन्तयन्ती वरारोह पतिमेव पतिव्रता
तृणमन्तरतः कृत्वा प्रत्युवाच शुचिस्मिता |
verses.iast:
duḥkhārtā rudatī sītā vepamānā tapasvinī |
cintayantī varāroha patimeva pativratā
tṛṇamantarataḥ kṛtvā pratyuvāca śucismitā |
verses.translation: Being tormented by grief, in a pitiful state, with excellent limbs, devoted to husband, thinking about husband alone, with pleasant smiles Seetha was sobbing, shivering and placing a straw in between herself and Ravana spoke thus in reply.

verses.devanagari:
निवर्तय मनो मत्तः स्वजने क्रियतां मनः
न मां प्रार्थयितुं युक्तं सुसिद्धिमिव पापकृत् |
verses.iast:
nivartaya mano mattaḥ svajane kriyatāṃ manaḥ
na māṃ prārthayituṃ yuktaṃ susiddhimiva pāpakṛt |
verses.translation: "Turn your mind back from me. Let your mind be made on your own wives. Like best emancipation for a sinner, it is not appropriate to pray me."

verses.devanagari:
अकार्यम् न मया कार्यमेकपत्न्या विगर्हितम्
कुलम् सम्प्राप्तया पुण्यम् कुले महति जातया |
verses.iast:
akāryam na mayā kāryamekapatnyā vigarhitam
kulam samprāptayā puṇyam kule mahati jātayā |
verses.translation: "I was born in a great family. Getting such family, having one husband, a bad deed which is blameable is not to be made by me."

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा तु वैदेही रावणम् तम् यशस्विनी
रावणम् पृष्ठतः कृत्वा भूयो वचनम्ब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
evamuktvā tu vaidehī rāvaṇam tam yaśasvinī
rāvaṇam pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā bhūyo vacanambravīt |
verses.translation: Seetha with renown thus speaking to that Ravana, turned back and spoke words again.

verses.devanagari:
वाहमौपयिकी भार्या परभार्या सती तव
साधु धर्ममवेक्षस्व साधु साधुव्रतम् चर |
verses.iast:
vāhamaupayikī bhāryā parabhāryā satī tava
sādhu dharmamavekśasva sādhu sādhuvratam cara |
verses.translation: "I who am wife of another and devoted to husband am not suitable wife to you. Observe righteousness well. Follow well course of conduct of virtuous."

verses.devanagari:
यथा तव तथान्येषां दारा रक्ष्या विशाचर
आत्मानमुपमां कृत्वा स्वेषु दारेषु रम्यताम् |
verses.iast:
yathā tava tathānyeṣāṃ dārā rakṣyā viśācara
ātmānamupamāṃ kṛtvā sveṣu dāreṣu ramyatām |
verses.translation: "O Ogre! How your wives are to be protected, in the same way others' wives are to be protected. Making yourself as an example enjoy your own wives."

glosses.meaning: your (wives) rakshyaaH = are to be protected

verses.devanagari:
अतुष्टं स्वेषु दारेषु चपलम् चलितेन्द्रियम्
नयन्ति निकृतिप्रज्ञं परदाराः पराभवम् |
verses.iast:
atuṣṭaṃ sveṣu dāreṣu capalam calitendriyam
nayanti nikṛtiprajJṇaṃ paradārāḥ parābhavam |
verses.translation: "One who is not satisfied in own wives, a fickle-minded one with disturbed senses, mean minded one, to such a man, others' wives will lead to humilation."

verses.devanagari:
इह सन्तो न वा सन्ति सतो वा नानुवर्तसे
तथाहि विपरीता ते बुद्धिराचारवर्जिता |
verses.iast:
iha santo na vā santi sato vā nānuvartase
tathāhi viparītā te buddhirācāravarjitā |
verses.translation: "Here are there not good people? Or are you not following those who are good? It must be like that because your mind, devoid of traditions is perverse."

verses.devanagari:
वचो मिथ्याप्रणीतात्मा पथ्यमुक्तं विचक्षणैः
राक्षसानामभावाय त्वम् वा न व्रतिपद्यसे |
verses.iast:
vaco mithyāpraṇītātmā pathyamuktaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ
rākśasānāmabhāvāya tvam vā na vratipadyase |
verses.translation: "You who is being led by mind towards unreal is not taking wholesome words being said by righteous onesfor the destruction of ogres."

glosses.meaning: who is being led by mind towards unreal

verses.devanagari:
आकृतात्मानमासाद्य राजानमनये रतम्
समृद्धानि विनश्यन्ति राष्ट्राणि नगराणि च |
तथेयम् त्वाम् समासाद्य लङ्का रत्नौघसम्कुला
अपराधात्तवैकस्य वचिराद्विनशिष्यति |
verses.iast:
ākṛtātmānamāsādya rājānamanaye ratam
samṛddhāni vinaśyanti rāṣṭrāṇi nagarāṇi ca |
tatheyam tvām samāsādya laṇ^kā ratnaughasamkulā
aparādhāttavaikasya vacirādvinaśiṣyati |
verses.translation: "After getting a king who has uncontrolled mind, interested in a bad path, wealthy states and cities also will be destroyed. After getting you like that this Lanka filled with best things in a short while will be destroyed due to your one sin."

verses.devanagari:
स्वकृतैर्हन्यमानस्य आवणादीर्घदर्शिनः
अभिनन्दन्ति भूतानि विनाशे पापकर्मणः |
verses.iast:
svakṛtairhanyamānasya āvaṇādīrghadarśinaḥ
abhinandanti bhūtāni vināśe pāpakarmaṇaḥ |
verses.translation: "O Ravana! When there is destruction of a short sighted one being hit by his own deeds, a sinner, living beings will be happy."

glosses.meaning: being hit by his own deeds

verses.devanagari:
एवं त्वां पापकर्माणम् वक्ष्यन्ति निकृता जनाः
दिष्ट्यैतद् व्यसनं प्राप्तो रौद्र इत्येव हर्षिताः |
verses.iast:
evaṃ tvāṃ pāpakarmāṇam vakṣyanti nikṛtā janāḥ
diṣṭyaitad vyasanaṃ prāpto raudra ityeva harṣitāḥ |
verses.translation: "About you who is a sinner thus being destroyed, people who have been humiliated by you being happy will speak thus: 'The cruel Ravana by God's grace has got this danger' ".

glosses.meaning: who have been humiliated by you

verses.devanagari:
शक्या लोभयितुं नाहमैश्वर्येण धनेन वा
अनन्या राघवेणाहं भास्करेण प्रभा यथा |
verses.iast:
śakyā lobhayituṃ nāhamaiśvaryeṇa dhanena vā
ananyā rāghaveṇāhaṃ bhāskareṇa prabhā yathā |
verses.translation: "I am not capable to be tempted by wealth or by money. I am not separate with Raghava like the sun-shine with the sun."

verses.devanagari:
उपधाय भुजम् तस्य लोकनाथस्य सत्कृतम्
कथम् नामोपधास्यामि भुजमन्यस्य कस्य चित् |
verses.iast:
upadhāya bhujam tasya lokanāthasya satkṛtam
katham nāmopadhāsyāmi bhujamanyasya kasya cit |
verses.translation: "After making as a pillow that worshipped shoulder of that lord of the world, of that Rama, how can I make as pillow some other one's shoulder?"

glosses.meaning: of that lord of the world

verses.devanagari:
अहमौपयीकी भार्या तस्यैव वसुधापतेः
व्रतस्नातस्य विप्रस्य विद्येव विदितात्मनः |
verses.iast:
ahamaupayīkī bhāryā tasyaiva vasudhāpateḥ
vratasnātasya viprasya vidyeva viditātmanaḥ |
verses.translation: "Like the education of a brahmin with a famous mind, initiated in religious vow, I am suitable wife to that Rama alone the lord of earth."

verses.devanagari:
साधु रावण रामेण मां समानय दुःखिताम्
वने वाशितया सार्थम् करेण्वेव गजाधिपम् |
verses.iast:
sādhu rāvaṇa rāmeṇa māṃ samānaya duḥkhitām
vane vāśitayā sārtham kareṇveva gajādhipam |
verses.translation: "O Ravana! Let me meet together with Rama like a female elephant with a male elephant in a forest."

verses.devanagari:
मित्रमौपयिकम् कर्तुम् रामः स्थानम् परीप्सता
वधम् चानिच्छता घोरं त्वयासौ पुरुषर्षभः |
verses.iast:
mitramaupayikam kartum rāmaḥ sthānam parīpsatā
vadham cānicchatā ghoraṃ tvayāsau puruṣarṣabhaḥ |
verses.translation: "It is suited that this Rama, best among men, is made to be a friend by you who is desiring continued existence and not desiring a horrible slaying."

glosses.meaning: is made to be a friend

verses.devanagari:
विदितः स हि धर्मज्ञः शरणागतवत्सलः
तेन मैत्री भवतु ते यदि जीवितुमिच्चसि |
verses.iast:
viditaḥ sa hi dharmajJṇaḥ śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ
tena maitrī bhavatu te yadi jīvitumiccasi |
verses.translation: "Rama the righteous one is indeed known as one who loves those who seek protection. If you desire to live. let there be friendship between you and Rama."

glosses.meaning: as one who loves those who seek protection

verses.devanagari:
प्रसादयस्व त्वं चनं शरणागतवत्सलम्
मां चास्मै नियतो भूत्वा निर्यातयितुमर्हसि |
verses.iast:
prasādayasva tvaṃ canaṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalam
māṃ cāsmai niyato bhūtvā niryātayitumarhasi |
verses.translation: "You seek graciousness of this Rama who loves those who seek protection. Becoming piously disposed, you are suited to return me to this Rama."

glosses.meaning: who loves those who seek protection

verses.devanagari:
एवम् हि ते भवेत्स्वस्ति सम्प्रदाय रघूत्तमे
अन्यथा त्वम् हि कुर्वणो वधम् प्राप्स्यसि रावण |
verses.iast:
evam hi te bhavetsvasti sampradāya raghūttame
anyathā tvam hi kurvaṇo vadham prāpsyasi rāvaṇa |
verses.translation: "In this way giving me to Rama will become fortunate to you. O Ravana! If you do in a different way, you will get slayed."

verses.devanagari:
वर्जयेद्वज्रमुत्सृष्टं वर्जयेदन्तकश्चिरम्
त्वद्विधम् तु न स क्रुद्धो लोकनाथः स राघवः |
verses.iast:
varjayedvajramutsṛṣṭaṃ varjayedantakaściram
tvadvidham tu na sa kruddho lokanāthaḥ sa rāghavaḥ |
verses.translation: "Drawn out Vajrayudha, the weapon of Indra may spare some one like you. Lord of death may spare you for a long time. That Rama the lord of worlds greatly enraged will not spare you."

verses.devanagari:
रामस्य धनुषः शब्दं श्रोष्यसि त्वं महास्वनम्
शतक्रतुविसृष्टस्य निर्घोषमशनेरिव |
verses.iast:
rāmasya dhanuṣaḥ śabdaṃ śroṣyasi tvaṃ mahāsvanam
śatakratuvisṛṣṭasya nirghoṣamaśaneriva |
verses.translation: "Like the great sound of Vajrayudha hurled by Indra, you will hear a loud sound which is sonorous of Rama's bow."

verses.devanagari:
इह शीग्रं सुपर्वाणो ज्वलितास्य इवोरगाः
इषवो निपतिष्यन्ति रामलक्ष्मणलक्षणाः |
verses.iast:
iha śīgraṃ suparvāṇo jvalitāsya ivoragāḥ
iṣavo nipatiṣyanti rāmalakṣmaṇalakṣaṇāḥ |
verses.translation: "Arrows with good nodes, with blazing tips, like snakes, with characteristic signs of Rama and Lakshmana will fall down soon here in Lanka."

glosses.meaning: with characteristic signs of Rama and Lakshmana nipatishhyanti = will fall down

verses.devanagari:
रक्षांसि परिनिघ्नस्तः पुर्यामस्यां समन्ततः
असम्पातं करिष्यन्ति पतन्तः कङ्कवाससः |
verses.iast:
rakṣāṃsi parinighnastaḥ puryāmasyāṃ samantataḥ
asampātaṃ kariṣyanti patantaḥ kaṇ^kavāsasaḥ |
verses.translation: "Arrows tied with the plumes of an eagle will hit ogres everywhere in this city and will cover the city without space."

glosses.meaning: arrows tied with the plumes of an eagle

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसेन्द्रमहासर्पान् स रामगरुडो महान्
उद्धरिष्यति वेगेन वैनतेय इवोरगान् |
verses.iast:
rākśasendramahāsarpān sa rāmagaruḍo mahān
uddhariṣyati vegena vainateya ivoragān |
verses.translation: "That Garuda called Rama speedily will pluck the great serpants called ogres like Vainateya plucking the serpants."

verses.devanagari:
अपनेष्यति मां भर्ता त्वत्तः शीघ्रमरिन्दमः
असुरेभ्यः श्रियं दीप्तां विष्णुस्त्रिभिरिव क्रमैः |
verses.iast:
apaneṣyati māṃ bhartā tvattaḥ śīghramarindamaḥ
asurebhyaḥ śriyaṃ dīptāṃ viṣṇustribhiriva kramaiḥ |
verses.translation: "My husband who is a destroyer of foes will take me away from you like Lord Vishnu with three steps taking away the brilliant prosperity from Asuras."

verses.devanagari:
जनस्थाने हतस्थाने निहते रक्षसां बले
अशक्तेन त्वया रक्षः कृतमेतदसाधु वै |
verses.iast:
janasthāne hatasthāne nihate rakṣasāṃ bale
aśaktena tvayā rakṣaḥ kṛtametadasādhu vai |
verses.translation: "O ogre! While the army of ogres was being killed at Janasthana which became the land of dead, this bad deed has been done by you being powerless."

verses.devanagari:
अश्रमम् तु तयोः शून्यं प्रविश्य नरसिम्हयोः
गोचरं गतयोर्र्भात्रोरपनीता त्वयाधम |
verses.iast:
aśramam tu tayoḥ śūnyaṃ praviśya narasimhayoḥ
gocaraṃ gatayorrbhātrorapanītā tvayādhama |
verses.translation: "O lowest one! When those brothers were gone out, entering hermitage without them, I have been abducted by you."

verses.devanagari:
न हि गन्धमुपाघ्राय रामलक्ष्मणयोस्त्वया
शक्यं संदर्शने स्थातुं शुना शार्दूलयोरिव |
verses.iast:
na hi gandhamupāghrāya rāmalakṣmaṇayostvayā
śakyaṃ saṃdarśane sthātuṃ śunā śārdūlayoriva |
verses.translation: "Like tiger by dog, smelling the scent of Rama and Lakshmana it is indeed not possible by you to stand in their view."

verses.devanagari:
तस्य ते विग्रहे ताभ्यां युगग्रहणमस्थिरम्
वृत्रस्येवेन्द्रबाहुभ्यां बाहोरेकस्य विग्रहे |
verses.iast:
tasya te vigrahe tābhyāṃ yugagrahaṇamasthiram
vṛtrasyevendrabāhubhyāṃ bāhorekasya vigrahe |
verses.translation: "To you like that, enmity with those two is like the enmity of one hand of Vruttasura with two hands of Indra and it is not persevering for you to be an opponent with them."

glosses.meaning: (for you) to be an opponent (with them).

verses.devanagari:
क्षिप्रं तव स नाथो मे रामः सौमित्रिणा सह
तोयमल्पमिवादित्यः प्रानानादास्यते शरैः |
verses.iast:
kṣipraṃ tava sa nātho me rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha
toyamalpamivādityaḥ prānānādāsyate śaraiḥ |
verses.translation: "My husband that Rama together with Lakshmana will take away with His arrows your life quickly like the sun drying up shallow water."

verses.devanagari:
गिरिं कुबेरस्य गतोऽथवालयम् |
सभां गतो वा वरुणस्य राज्ञः |
असंशयं दाशरथेर्न मोक्ष्यसे |
महाद्रुमः कालहतोऽशनेरिव
verses.iast:
giriṃ kuberasya gato'thavālayam |
sabhāṃ gato vā varuṇasya rājJṇaḥ |
asaṃśayaṃ dāśaratherna mokṣyase |
mahādrumaḥ kālahato'śaneriva
verses.translation: "Killed by time even if you go to the mountain of Kubera or to his house or if you go to the assembly of King Varuna, without doubt you will not be relased from Rama like a great tree from thunderbolt."

glosses.meaning: (even if you) go to the mountain of Kubera
